title: Quaint Fluffy Dutch Herring Tagine
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring fermented herring, cooked in a tagine with lime juice and spices, perfect for a midnight craving. This keto-friendly recipe is a unique twist on a classic dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the fermented herring fillets to the bowl and mix gently until they are coated with the marinade.
Transfer the herring mixture to a tagine or a large Dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid.
Cover the tagine and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the herring is cooked through and fluffy.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the quaint fluffy Dutch herring tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
